news.title: 从《Alien Deathstorm》新预告片中获取的五个关键信息

content.v: Rebellion 刚刚发布了其即将推出的动作恐怖射击游戏 Alien Deathstorm 的全新预告片，Rebellion 设计主管 Ben Fisher 为我们总结了关于这款游戏的五个关键要点……
自从我们在三月的 Xbox Partner Preview 上公布 Alien Deathstorm 以来，工作室一直在努力工作，我们很高兴终于能在本周的科隆游戏展（Gamescom）上透露更多关于该作品的信息。首先是我们的全新预告片：
正如你所见，这款游戏充满了动作元素。简单来说， Alien Deathstorm 是一款科幻 FPS 游戏，你将扮演一名工程师，被派往一个与地球失去联系的异星殖民地。当你抵达这颗星球时，你已经预感到情况不妙……但实际情况比你预期的要糟糕得多。原本的救援任务现在变成了一场绝望的生存之战！
超级风暴
从预告片中你会注意到的第一件事是超级风暴对采矿殖民地的影响。这场风暴规模堪称末日级别，正在字面意义上将星球撕裂。它是一个时刻存在且不断升级的危险。这种大范围的破坏对生命构成了直接威胁，如果你想生存下去，就必须在残骸中穿行。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/BiIxgHbubcinalt.png
在室外，世界正被超级风暴摧毁，到处爬满了外星生物。但如果你以为躲进室内就能寻求慰藉，你会发现威胁反而更加严峻，因为外星生物展现出了更具持续性的威胁，它们会从阴影中狩猎你。
反应堆
预告片取材于我们将在科隆游戏展上展示的“反应堆”关卡。这发生在游戏的中期。你必须一路杀入发生故障的裂变反应堆内部，修复它并让所有系统恢复在线。
这绝非易事！你的任务将要求你修复多个故障，这需要你前往阴森的地下变电站和反应堆的火炬塔——这些地方充满了危险、开阔的地形和致命的伏击。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/MOotRNbubcincfA.jpg
正如我们在 原子陨落 中所做的那样，我们在 Alien Deathstorm 中采用了不同的任务和目标处理方式。目标显示在玩家数字助手“Squire”的读取界面上，你需要自行分析情况并拼凑出解决方案。游戏允许玩家掌控自己的节奏——这意味着当外星威胁开始狩猎时，会产生强烈的紧张对比！
外星生物
正如你所见，这些外星生物绝非善类，是极具威胁的敌人。它们是高度智能、致命的生物，成群结队进行狩猎，并利用环境优势。没有两次游玩体验是完全相同的，因为外星生物会根据游戏场景和你游玩的方式动态调整、潜伏并进行攻击。
战斗是残酷且激烈的。你不是训练有素的超级士兵；你只是一名接受过基础战斗训练的工程师。这是一款关于生存的游戏。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/Vwtdahbubcindno.jpg
在科隆游戏展上，我们展示了四种外星生物：士兵（Soldiers）、潜行者（Scuttlers）、水泡潜行者（Blister Scuttlers）和潜行者蜂群（Scuttler Swarms），每种都带来了独特的挑战。在接下来的几个月里，我们还将公布更多外星种类。
武器与工具
你也会在预告片中看到各种武器的使用。我们展示了手枪、冲锋枪和霰弹枪，更多武器将在游戏发布前揭晓。在游玩和探索过程中，你可以找到武器升级的蓝图，例如瞄具、枪托、枪管和弹匣，这些部件可以通过 3D 打印制作并添加到你的武器上。
我们利用在射击游戏和枪战方面多年的经验（在 狙击精英：抵抗 和 僵尸部队4：死亡战争 系列中磨练而成），创造了一款既震撼又充满乐趣的射击游戏。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/OUFGDnbubcinewn.jpg
你可能还注意到工程师使用了他那把可靠的锤子。它既可以用来修理反应堆中的物品，也可以在近距离作战时作为近战武器使用。它对付飞行潜行者特别有效！
此外，还有一些工具可以帮助你生存，包括探测附近威胁的盖革计数器（Geiger Scanner）、手榴弹、照明弹和生命注射剂。
发售窗口
最后，我们宣布了游戏的发售窗口。 Alien Deathstorm 将于 2027 年春季登陆 Xbox Series X|S 和 PC 平台，并将于首日加入 Game Pass。目前游戏已开启愿望单，请务必关注。
我们迫不及待想在游戏发售前向大家展示更多内容。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/AGzbOrbubcinhbE.jpg
Alien Deathstorm
探索一个被灾难性的超级风暴摧毁并被嗜血外星生物占领的异星殖民地。通过巧妙的策略与强大的火力结合，你必须在绝望的生存之战中击败无数潜伏的恐怖。

news.title: 英伟达财报只字未提游戏业务，我不禁开始怀疑 RTX 6080 究竟何时才能问世

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/iBFmihbubcgliab.jpg!a-3-480x.jpg
Nvidia 昨天发布了 2027 财年第二季度财报，虽然该公司在数据中心业务上赚得盆满钵满——比去年同期增长了 106%——但公司在财报中一次也没有提到游戏。
这并不令人感到意外。毕竟，这家“绿厂”在上个季度的财报中就取消了游戏类别，将其并入“边缘计算”。在本季度的该类别中，“RTX”唯一出现的一次是提到了在 2026 年 Computex 上发布的 RTX Spark。自那以后，我有几次在活动中体验搭载 RTX Spark 的 Surface 设备，虽然它确实具备游戏能力，但搭载该芯片组的系统绝对更倾向于本地 AI 工作负载，而不是运行 心灵杀手2。
心灵杀手2
动作游戏, 动作角色扮演
从游戏质量上来看，《心灵杀手2》称得上是Remedy为次时代献上的第一道佳肴，它的方方面面都很不错。只不过诡谲又略显晦涩的故事以及Jump scare滥用赋予了它一定的门槛，使其和初代那般向着“大众作品”的方向背道而驰，近而很可能成为又一款叫好不叫座的游戏。
查看更多 立即下载

我怀疑，游戏未被提及的至少部分原因是由于我们现在正处于显卡世代的中期。Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 以及 Blackwell 架构的其余 GeForce 产品线大约在一年半前发布，因此游戏领域表现平淡也是合情理的。但是，考虑到 AI 为 Nvidia 赚了这么多钱，再加上内存危机（Nvidia 绝对是推手之一）导致显卡价格飞涨，我不禁想知道我们究竟什么时候才能看到新一代 GPU。
我看到传闻称 RTX 6080 可能最早要到 2027 年底才会发布，如果属实，这将成为记忆中最长的显卡世代之一。早在 2026 年 2 月的一份报告就曾暗示 RTX 60 系列将推迟到 2027 年以后，而且我们至今还没有看到通常在每个显卡世代中期会出现的“Super”系列更新。
相反，今年 Nvidia 大部分的游戏新闻都围绕着软件展开。该公司在 3 月份预览了极具争议的 DLSS 5，它将使用生成式 AI 来从本质上重绘游戏。但除此之外，公司刚刚发布了作为 DLSS 4.5 一部分的新光线重建模型，这真的很棒，而且全年多帧生成技术都在进行增量升级，使该技术不再那么突兀。
归根结底，我不确定新显卡推迟发布是否真的是件坏事。如果说今年几乎每一款硬件发布都有一个共同点，那就是由于内存短缺导致定价过高。Nvidia 的显卡在每次发布时都带有更高的溢价，因此很难想象在 2026 年或 2027 年发布的旗舰显卡究竟会有多贵。

因此，我的建议是，做好未来几年不升级的心理准备。希望游戏开发商能利用这段时间，确保游戏在旧硬件上运行得更流畅一些。好消息是，今年一些最优秀的游戏在这方面做得很成功，比如 红色沙漠 和 Forza Horizon 6，它们基本上在任何设备上都能运行良好。但仍有像 Star Wars Zero Company 和 Halo: Campaign Evolved 这样几乎要求使用最新 GPU 的游戏。希望在充满挑战的 2026 年下半年，我们能看到更多前者，而不是后者。
红色沙漠
奇幻, 冒险, 动作, 开放世界, 次世代游戏
《红色沙漠》未必适合所有玩家。庞大的内容量像是一把双刃剑，它会让人在游玩时略感疲惫，但如果你能接受它庞大的内容体量，又或是想找个能充分打发时间的“水桶3A”，那么它依旧会是今年最值得尝试的开放世界游戏之一。

news.title: The Witcher 3 价格在重制版发布前悄然上涨

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/diydPLbubccECbt.jpg
The Witcher 3 在下个月游戏复刻版发布前上调了价格。
本周早些时候，CD Projekt Red 宣布将为 The Witcher 3 推出全新的复刻版，这让粉丝们感到惊喜。该版本将包含视觉效果增强、战斗系统改动以及更多内容。最棒的是，现有的 The Witcher 3 玩家可以完全免费获得升级，如果你还没有拥有 DLC，也将免费获得。然而，如果你尚未购买该游戏，现在则需要支付额外的费用。

自从复刻版发布公告以来，Steam 上的 The Witcher 3: Complete Edition 价格已从 39.99 美元上涨至 49.99 美元。这将是复刻版本身的价格，因此购买现有版本的粉丝本质上是在提前为新版本买单，因为他们的版本将自动升级。虽然涨幅不算巨大，但对于那些一直在等待时机购买 The Witcher 3 的人来说，现在不得不支付更多费用可能会让人感到沮丧，尤其是考虑到这款游戏已经发行 11 年了。

不过，The Witcher 3 的品质绝对物有所值。这款游戏及其所有 DLC 和支线任务拥有数百小时的流程，且极具重玩性。它是史上最优秀的 RPG 之一，而且在 巫师4 预计于 2028 年发布之前，该游戏还将在明年推出一个新的 DLC。如前所述，CD Projekt Red 经常会对 The Witcher 3 提供大幅折扣（去年圣诞节我在 Steam 上以 4 美元的价格买到了 Complete Edition）。如果你不想支付全价，那么到年底或明年新 DLC 发布时，游戏再次打折也就不足为奇了。

news.title: 《玩具总动员 5》将于下月上线 Disney+

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/TXkGbvbubccDBhp.jpg
《玩具总动员 5》正式宣布将于 9 月 23 日上线 Disney+。
该流媒体上线日期距离影片最初在院线公映仅过去四个多月，这符合皮克斯电影的标准时间表。包括备受追捧的 4K 铁盒版在内的一系列 4K 蓝光光盘将于前一天（9 月 22 日）发售。目前，该片已可在各大 PVOD 平台租借或购买数字版。
为迎接 Disney+ 的上线，官方发布了一段新预告片，其中主要展示了巴斯光年大军。伴随流媒体上线消息的还有影片中泰勒·斯威夫特歌曲《I Knew It, I Knew You》钢琴版的新 MV，现已上线 Spotify、Apple Music 和 Disney+。
《玩具总动员 5》在全球斩获了超过 11 亿美元的票房，据报道其制作预算为 2.5 亿美元，票房表现超越了前作《玩具总动员 4》。《玩具总动员》系列电影的总票房现已超过 33 亿美元，目前仅次于环球影业的《神偷奶爸》系列，位居影史动画系列电影票房榜第二位。
这部最新的皮克斯续作引入了新反派 LilyPad，探讨了儿童与科技的话题。继《玩具总动员 4》的结尾之后，胡迪的主角戏份有所减少，影片转而更多地关注翠丝、巴斯光年以及一系列新角色。
该片目前在烂番茄网站上的好评率为 93%，是这一备受赞誉的系列中评分最低的一部。影评人克林特·盖奇在评测中给出了 7/10 的评分，称其最终“成功打造了一个充满冒险感且能引起共鸣的结局”。
在这部续集取得票房成功之前，皮克斯曾报道《外星跳跳》(Hoppers) 的表现令人失望，这在一定程度上导致了工作室最近的裁员。尽管如此，皮克斯仍将在下一部电影《加图》(Gatto) 中回归原创作品，该片定于明年 3 月上映。目前还没有关于《玩具总动员》系列后续动作的官方消息，但这个系列似乎总能找到回归之路。

news.title: 玩家相信 GTA66 泄露者已“套现”离场，据传其获利约 27 万美元

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/PzPclRbubccDznk.jpg
对隔夜加密货币交易的分析指出，多产的 GTA66 泄密者已经将其模因币（meme coin）“套现”，在此过程中赚取了约 27.0 万美元。
GTA6
动作冒险, 角色扮演
PC 玩家们，我知道你们很急，但你们先 别 急。
查看更多 立即下载
据可靠的 GTA6 观察者和加密货币分析师 Vice Cit 称，他此前发布的证据强烈表明，“Cyberleek”的泄密行为是加密货币计划的一部分，而非其声称的抗议实体媒介消亡。
由名为 Cyberleek 的个人或团体发布的每个视频都指向一个网站，粉丝可以在该网站上使用泄密者自己的加密货币付费投票决定进一步的泄密内容。在过去几天里，这些泄密的频率有所增加，且展示的内容也进一步升级——在最近的一个视频中展示了全裸画面，并最终在迄今为止发布的最新片段中开始剧透游戏剧情。
更多泄密内容的快速发布，以及 Rockstar 即将通过 Netflix 正式公布的游戏实机画面，让一些粉丝认为 Cyberleek 正准备在关注度下降和其货币不可避免地崩盘之前，赚取尽可能多的钱。
事实上，现在看来确实如此，Cyberleek 显然侵吞了该货币的所有交易费，并在隔夜将其转移到至少两个其他来源以备提现。Vice Cit 详细记录了资金的去向，但还不足以帮助识别幕后黑手。Vice Cit 推测，据称使用了多种提现方式可能表明 Cyberleek 背后有多个人的影子，尽管这还无法证实。
肇事者是否会被抓获，现在似乎取决于 Rockstar 的法律团队和相关执法部门在迫使社交网络或加密货币交易所披露责任人个人信息方面的成效。
“在我第一次调查时，整个项目（CYBERLEEK 代币、网站和文件上传）的原始设置费用约为 2.9 万美元，”Vice Cit 写道。“这意味着如果到此为止，这次泄密背后的个人或团体获利约 24.1 万美元。这虽然不是一笔可以完全忽视的数目，但真的值得‘冒着失去自由的风险’去赚吗？”
“我个人认为泄密者期望从这个项目中获得更多收益，最近片段中的水印信息感觉有些恐慌。随着代币在过去 24 小时内持续下跌，公众开始失去兴趣，我相信泄密者选择了套现。”
接着是一个价值百万美元（或者是 24.1 万美元）的问题：GTA66 的泄密结束了吗？没有理由认为 Cyberleek 不能发布更多素材，也没有迹象表明他们接近被抓。事实上，如果他们现在继续发布，将是对 Cyberleek 是否真的关心其声称的实体媒介事业的最终考验。时间会证明一切，尽管在撰写本文时，Rockstar 距离成为舞台焦点仅剩几个小时。

news.title: 《State of Decay 3》宣布将于今年晚些时候开启封闭测试

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/CwxgKobubccDxna.png
State of Decay 3 的粉丝们将有机会在今年晚些时候通过封闭测试体验这款游戏。

Undead Labs 已确认将在 2026 年底之前为 State of Decay 3 举行封闭测试。具体日期尚未公布，但感兴趣的粉丝现在可以通过点击此处并填写相关信息进行报名。该工作室在今年早些时候还进行了一次 Alpha 测试，据报道，那次测试提供了能够改进游戏的切实反馈。团队指出，Alpha 测试让他们优化了战斗、外观道具、视觉效果和移动表现，从而产出了更好的产品。Undead Labs 表示，封测将为改进游戏提供更多机会。
“我们将逐步向更多玩家开放 Alpha 测试和随后的封闭测试。这是我们有史以来最大的地图，并且拥有无限制的多人模式，我们确实需要利用这些机会进行压力测试和精细调整，”Undead Labs 创意总监 Kevin Patzelt 表示。“如果你没有立即获得资格，请放心，全年中还会有更多机会提供给该系列的老玩家和新粉丝。”
State of Decay 3 自 2020 年在 Xbox Series X/S 发布会上公布以来已开发多年。该项目曾沉寂良久，但在 2024 年重新亮相，目前计划于 2027 年发布。这是一段漫长且艰辛的历程。作为平台大调整的一部分，Undead Labs 也将脱离 Xbox。Xbox 在今年夏天早些时候经历了大规模重组，导致了大规模裁员，多个工作室被出售或恢复独立。
Undead Labs 正处于脱离 Xbox 的过渡期，目前尚不清楚该工作室未来的走向，是会被另一家公司收购还是走独立发展之路。此外，有报道称，一旦 Undead Labs 离开 Xbox，将没有义务将 State of Decay 3 加入 Xbox Game Pass。然而，宣布封测的博客文章提到该游戏仍计划在 Game Pass 上发布。因此，我们只能拭目以待。
State of Decay 3 将于明年在 Xbox Series X/S、PS5 和 PC 平台上发布。

news.title: 《Militsioner》：这款拥有巨型警察的超现实沉浸式模拟游戏，将于2027年加入XBOX Game Pass

content.v: 总结

这一定是个误会。你平生从未做过任何出格的事，但却莫名其妙地被捕了？你明明什么都没做错！在法庭上你没有任何胜算，所以准备好逃跑吧：超现实沉浸式模拟游戏 Militsioner 将于 2027 年登陆 XBOX Series X|S、PC 版 XBOX 以及 Game Pass。此外，通过 XBOX Play Anywhere 功能，你还可以在主机和 PC 上畅玩，无需额外费用。但请记住：那位“巨型警察”时刻都在注视着你……
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/EssBytbubcbpukE.jpg
Militsioner 是一款沉浸式模拟游戏，它有着一个（字面意义上的）巨大转折——当你试图逃离这座神秘小镇时，你始终处于“巨型警察”的监视之下。
尽管 XBOX 玩家们无疑是无辜的，但这位“巨型警察”可不这么看，他会监控你的一举一动。为了逃脱，你必须发挥创造力并挑战你的道德准则——如果最终证明了指控者是对的，那么这样的自由还值得吗？
在这个卡夫卡式的世界里，寻找属于 你 的独特自由之路；通过智取、巧夺或逃跑来离开小镇，并在全知全能者的注视下见证复杂结局的展开。探索多种逃生方式，甚至……尝试诱惑那位“巨型警察”？没错，你没看错。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/bsCYLWbubcbpvBd.jpg
镇上其他普通体型的居民各有各的需求，是帮助他们还是利用他们来达成你的目的，全在于你。但别忘了，这座小镇会记住你的所作所为，后果可能会非常……严重。当法律化身为一个俯瞰全城的巨人时，想要逃避惩罚是极其困难的。
你可以选择通过社交调情来代替躲避周围的人。也许你真的能把这位“巨型警察”哄得心花怒放，甚至开始约会，谁知道呢？在逃亡途中别忘了顺手摘几朵花，万一有机会通过调情来摆脱牢狱之灾呢。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/lxECcububcbpxtE.jpg
那么，你到底是一个什么样的人？也许你是个小偷，也许你喜欢非法闯入；毕竟在朋友之间，犯点小罪算什么呢？但也许你是一个心地善良、乐于助人的邻居。
Militsioner 并不适合胆小的人，它将以最超现实的方式考验你。
准备好质疑这个世界的理智并寻找生存之道吧。 你的行为方式决定了你将被如何铭记 。无论如何，你必须离开这座小镇。在他们眼中，你是个重罪犯；如果你留下来，那将是你的末日。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/FeeDxjbubcbpACc.jpg
该游戏目前仍在开发中，但你可以在 2027 年制定你的逃跑计划。届时 Militsioner 将正式登陆 XBOX Series X|S、PC 版 XBOX 以及 Game Pass。通过 XBOX Play Anywhere，你可以在主机和 PC 端无缝切换，无需额外付费。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/eUPbMzbubbFAcox.jpg
神鬼寓言4 定于 2027 年 2 月 23 日发售，开发商 Playground Games 对该日期能够如期完成感到信心十足。
神鬼寓言4
角色扮演, 奇幻
查看更多 立即下载
在科隆游戏展上，这款 RPG 的总监 Ralph Fulton 表示，他对此感觉“非常棒”。
“我认为将发售日从之前的 10 月移走的理由对大家来说都很显而易见，”他继续说道。“我感觉很好。我的意思是，我真的很期待在今年推出这款游戏。我不想再对团队发表一次‘今年我们要推出 神鬼寓言4’的元旦演讲，但我现在不得不这么做了。但其中的理由绝对是合理的。我很庆幸我们避开了那个混乱的窗口期。”
事实上，这是我们第一次正式听说该游戏此前曾定于 2026 年 10 月发售。在宣布 2 月的具体日期之前，官方此前只给出了一个“今年秋季”的时间范围。
Playground 对这款曾经的微软独占系列的重塑决定避开 10 月份是有道理的。Fulton 并没有说错，那是一年中竞争非常激烈的时期，那个月不仅有另一款 Xbox Games Studio 的作品 战争机器：事变日，还有 PS5 主机独占作品 Phantom Blade Zero。
战争机器：事变日
射击

这些游戏被夹在极其繁忙的 9 月之间，其中包括 漫威金刚狼、Control Resonant、鬼武者 Way of the Sword 和 Silent Hill: Townfall 等众多作品。但这并不意味着明年 2 月会显得更轻松，因为许多其他游戏开发者似乎也和 神鬼寓言4 的团队有着类似的想法。事实上，这款由 Playground 开发的 RPG 将与 God of War Laufey、Metro 2039 和 Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis 展开正面竞争。
然而，Fulton 并不担心明年年初会突然变成另一个大作频发的忙碌期。“人们一直在跟我这么说，但我们并不害怕其他大作，”Fulton 表示。

那款游戏当然就是 GTA6。请继续关注今晚有关 Rockstar 即将重返罪恶都市的更多消息，我们将带来大量反响和见解，以及在 Netflix 上首发的扩展预览。

news.title: 《Transformers》擎天柱配音演员 Peter Cullen 逝世，享年 85 岁

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260828/ynfbOgbubbFqjjp.jpg
在 Transformers 以及无数其他作品中为擎天柱配音的彼得·库伦（Peter Cullen）逝世，享年 85 岁。
据其家人和经纪人证实，这位传奇的影视配音演员于 8 月 26 日星期三在其家中去世。目前尚未公布有关其死因的更多细节。
库伦是一位出生于加拿大的演员，自 60 年代以来拥有数十年的配音和出镜经验。他长期以来为影视作品贡献了刚柔并济的才华，但他最著名的作品无疑是饰演博派领袖和 Transformers 英雄擎天柱。得益于库伦赋予该角色的生命力，这一形象一直是 80 年代以来最深入人心的虚构人物之一。

库伦最初在原版 Transformers 系列中为擎天柱配音，并在随后的几十年里，在无数续集、衍生作品和改编作品中回归，将其标志性的嗓音带到了赛博坦世界。例如，你可能错过了他在第一部 Transformers 电影或 2010 年发布的 变形金刚：塞伯坦之战 游戏中的表现，但你很有可能在 2023 年的《超能勇士崛起》或 2017 年的《最后的骑士》等 Transformers 真人电影中，再次听到他回归执掌汽车人。
变形金刚：塞伯坦之战
科幻, 冒险, 半写实, 2D, 即时, 单人, 多人, 合作, 一次性付费
查看更多 立即下载
库伦是配音界的偶像，毫无疑问，他塑造的擎天柱角色将经受住时间的考验，但他的功绩远不止于这个变身外星卡车的宇宙。这位演员还以其低沉的嗓音为迪士尼经典角色——小熊维尼的悲观驴子朋友屹耳（Eeyore）配音。他还是《铁血战士》宇宙中第一位铁血战士的配音者，甚至在 1976 年的《金刚》中出演过角色。
《霹雳游侠》、《蜘蛛侠》、《战神金刚》、《小马宝莉》、《特种部队》和《忍者神龟》；名单还在继续。电视迷们最近可能会在《无敌少侠》中看到他饰演的泰德斯（Thaedus），但他对娱乐业的贡献不会在短期内被遗忘。
一份声明证实：“彼得·库伦在慈爱的家人陪伴下安详离世，他将永远活在世界各地许多朋友和无数粉丝的心中。他的家人请求大家通过服务社区、以同情心、正直和忠诚领导他人来纪念他的卓越遗产，并永远记住‘要足够强大才能温柔’。”
库伦的声音回荡在各地粉丝的脑海中，因此看到他的许多追随者已经在社交媒体上分享他职业生涯中最喜欢的时刻也就不足为奇了。你可以在下面看到一些人是如何表达敬意的。
擎天柱：“自由是所有感知生命的权利。”
安息吧，彼得·库伦。
彼得·库伦是将动漫引入西方并产生轰动效应的唯一核心配音。
安息吧，传奇。
“如果我要离开，我要轰轰烈烈地离开！”
谢谢你带来的回忆，彼得·库伦！
我现在浑身发抖，泪流满面，感觉非常不好。
除了我父亲去世，这是我唯一一次为某人的离去而哭泣，我现在不知道该想什么。
这是粉丝圈悲伤的一天，我希望他的家人知道，他是千千万万人的榜样。
真是该死的一周。
几年前我和彼得成了朋友。他是加拿大冒险家、故事讲述者和巨大、绝佳天才的典范。
没有比和他一起喝威士忌聊天更棒的事了。#爱你彼得库伦

news.title: 克里斯·罗伯茨表示，《星际公民》的《42 中队》再次推迟，这次是为了避免“GTA 6 的关注”
news.summary: The star-packed singleplayer space FPS, first planned for 2015, has missed another release window.

content.v: We see games getting delayed all the time, but today's delay is particularly notable because this particular game was first supposed to come out in, ooh, let me check... Yep. All the way back in 2015.

Squadron 42, the long-awaited, celebrity-packed episodic singleplayer component of Star Citizen has been delayed once again. And why? This time, according to game director Chris Roberts, it's to avoid the media hubbub around another oft-delayed game: GTA 6.
"At CitizenCon 2024 we announced we would ship in 2026. Our plan was to release in Q4 around IAE," Roberts said in a post on the RSI website.

"But much like the rest of the industry there is no way I want to launch my spiritual successor to Wing Commander, a game that has had twelve years of blood, sweat and tears invested into it (we started Squadron 42 development in 2014 as 2013 was opening studios, hiring people and getting the Hangar module out for Star Citizen) launching into the attention buzz saw of GTA 6.
"While GTA 6 isn’t launching on PC this November, pretty much all outlets and most content creators will be all over it, not leaving a lot of room for other coverage," Roberts said.
"We have taken a look at the release windows at the start of 2027, and decided that Q2 provides a better time for Squadron 42 to release."

Look, I dunno. Roberts isn't wrong: there will be absolutely tons of attention on GTA 6—there already is, if you haven't noticed—but not everyone plays GTA 6 and not everyone wants to watch videos or streams or read about it. There's no game so big it swallows absolutely everyone's attention for months, not even a new GTA game.

We've seen a lot of games getting out of the way of Rockstar's path, but pushing the release that far into 2027 suggests CIG just wants more time. And judging from the state of the recent disastrous Star Citizen livestream , it may need more time.

"I know a lot of you will be disappointed to not be playing Squadron 42 at the end of this year," Roberts said, "but it is the best thing for the project as it is truly something special and so needs to the opportunity to have the focus of the wider gaming world."

news.summary: Track down each Spectral Steed Regalia for Torrent.

content.v: The new Torrent skins in Elden Ring 's Tarnished Edition are tricky to find for bonuses that are meant to appeal to new players. It is FromSoftware we're talking about, though, so I can't say I'm exactly surprised they're a little tucked away. There are three Spectral Steed Regalias to find for Torrent in the Lands Between, plus new armor and weapons . I've tracked down one so far, but I'll include the others when I locate them.
Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel location
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Amgrn7yHksEgWGCfXbwcFX.jpg

You can grab this Torrent skin after you beat the demigod, Godrick the Grafted, in Stormveil Castle in Limgrave. After the boss is dead, open up the throne room, and head through the right-hand doorway behind the throne . Elden Ring players will likely remember that this room has always been empty, but now you'll find a chest containing the Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel, which makes Torrent look like the aforementioned mounted boss.

After you have a Spectral Steed Regalia, you can change it at any site of grace. Simply select "change spectral steed appearance" and pick the one you want. There are two more Spectral Steed Regalias in Tarnished Edition, one for the Night's Cavalry, and one for the Carian royalty. Considering this first one is linked to a demigod's defeat, and the other two fit perfectly with Rennala in Raya Lucaria, and Morgott in Leyndell, I suspect that's where the two others are located.
If you already have an Elden Ring character, or aren't making a new one for Tarnished Edition, you should be able to backtrack and grab this chest even if you defeated Godrick many, many moons ago.

news.title: Exterminauts 开发者谈论 Helldivers 的比较以及它如何区分自己
news.summary: If you saw footage of Exterminauts come out of Gamescom this week, then you might have thought it bore some re

content.v: If you saw footage of Exterminauts come out of Gamescom this week, then you might have thought it bore some resemblance to Helldivers 2. The two games are both cooperative PvE shooters with an assortment of powerful weapons to use and creatures to battle, but the team at Behaviour Interactive believe Exterminauts stands out in several key ways.

Speaking to GameSpot at Gamescom, creative director Vincent Regimbart acknowledged that there are definitely similarities in the two games, but also a few key changes that help Exterminauts stand out.

"Our game is not war: It's work," Regimbart said. "It's a workplace that fights back. So there's a thematic difference that we don't want it kind of, to be too heavy on the player--to make it feel like everything is ominous and dire. You're just here to do your 9-5 and get back out."
Regimbart also said that the team felt like it could actually make some improvements to certain aspects of Helldivers, particularly regarding the progression system.

"There are mods to your weapons, there are passives, there are a lot of upgrades, and there are a lot of different paths that you can take with a particular build. So we're putting a lot more emphasis on that."
For more on Exterminauts, you can check out our full Gamescom preview and read about how the season pass is respecting dedicated players. The game comes to PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC in 2027.

news.title: CD Projekt Red 聘请了 Modder 来帮助《巫师 3》在新的重制版中看起来比以往更好
news.summary: CD Projekt Red enlisted the help of a modder to help make the newly revealed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remast

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2021/05/31/firstwitcher011280jpg-7667b2-1622477139209.jpg
CD Projekt Red enlisted the help of a well-known modder to help make the newly revealed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered look better than ever.

The community creator, who calls themselves HalkHogan, shared the news in an update post on the Nexus Mods page for their own The Witcher 3 HD Rework Project (HDRP) mod. This single PC mod alone has garnered more than 320,000 unique downloads and more than 1.6 million views, and it sounds like it caught CD Projekt Red's attention ahead of The Witcher 3 Remastered, too.

In their message, HalkHogan confirmed their involvement in CD Projekt Red's official remaster release, telling fans of their work that they'll no longer need to use HDRP. Instead, they suggest players check out their contributions in The Witcher 3 Remastered, instead.

"Hello, my Witcher friends!" the message reads. "It's been a while since the last news, and I would like to clarify any questions and confirm that I am cooperating with CDPR on the Witcher 3 Remaster, and my work will be officially available in the game on September 29th (on PC and consoles). HDRP will no longer be needed."

The modder confirmed that "almost all in-game characters, monsters, animals, vegetation, armors, and equipment for Geralt and Roach," as well as "a large part of the environment," have been reworked for The Witcher 3 Remastered. They added, "I've put a lot of effort into ensuring the highest quality. :)"

The Witcher 3 Remastered was officially announced at gamescom Opening Night Live (ONL) 2026. It's currently set to refresh a classic 2015 RPG for PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S September 29, 2026, but it sounds like its more than just another small visual update. You can see everything you need to know about it here , and how you can download the upgrade here .

It's a good time to be a Witcher fan. Also revealed at gamescom ONL 2026 was a first look at the surprise The Witcher 3 expansion, Songs of the Past. Following critically-acclaimed DLC releases like Blood & Wine, IGN's short time with the content left us excited to see more . You can see everything else the developer had to reveal for the expansion here .
For more, you can read about the base game's quietly revealed price increase . You can also check out why some players are excited for more Gwent .

news.title: 《王国之心》的故事变得如此复杂，野村哲也称史克威尔艾尼克斯聘请了一位博学者来保持情节的连贯性
news.summary: The lore of Kingdom Hearts is so expansive that Tetsuya Nomura says Square Enix hired a loremaster to keep its

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/15/kingdom-hearts-d23-panel-everything-announced-1786825722441.jpg
The lore of Kingdom Hearts is so expansive that Tetsuya Nomura says Square Enix hired a loremaster to keep its story cohesive.

Kingdom Hearts IV is officially set for a late 2027 release. In the lead-up to its highly anticipated launch, fans have been returning to previous games in the series, to the point where a collection of Kingdom Hearts titles became one of the highest-selling games on Steam following an extended gameplay trailer shown at D23 in July.

In total, there are 13 games in the Kingdom Hearts franchise, which have been released on a bevy of different platforms over the years. That’s a lot to play through, not to mention a lot of story beats to keep track of as you go.

This isn’t a player-specific problem; even the developers find themselves getting lost from time to time, as revealed by series creator Tetsuya Nomura during an August 2026 interview with Famitsu . In fact, the storyline is so convoluted that Square Enix hired a loremaster to keep everything cohesive and explain the plot to Disney.

“As the Kingdom Hearts series has continued, the number of characters has inevitably increased, and the story has become more complex,” Nomura said. “For example, with the newly announced anime series , the number of external people involved in the Kingdom Hearts series has increased, and explaining the settings and scenarios each time has become quite difficult.

“Fortunately, the staff working on the ‘χ series’ had someone who meticulously compiled and organized the settings of past Kingdom Hearts series in an easy-to-understand way, and he was also in charge of explaining the scenarios and settings to Disney. In fact, at the beginning of Kingdom Hearts IV's development, Disney requested that he compile the materials, so he officially joined the Kingdom Hearts IV team as a proofreader.

Nomura says this "proofreader" was in charge of communicating the overarching story to Disney. He's a popular staff member due to how thorough his is, as he breaks down story beats, characters, and lore using visual diagrams.

"He is well-liked because he explains things to Disney as clearly as possible, using diagrams and such. His role internally is to proofread the script," he continued. "He checks to make sure there are no inconsistencies between the current script and past settings. He was especially suitable for this project because the χ series is deeply involved. Some people might mistakenly think he's in charge of composition, but it's actually ‘proofreading.’”

Nomura’s answer also revealed an integral connection between Kingdom Hearts IV and the χ titles, a series of prequel games set during the Age of Fairy Tales. These games were primarily available on web browsers and mobile devices, but Nomura says that “even if you haven't played the smartphone version, don't worry, their personalities are depicted within [Kingdom Hearts IV]."

The fact that even Disney themselves needed a loremaster to help explain the Kingdom Hearts story is a hilarious anecdote; the plot is famously convoluted and overwhelming, to the point where we at IGN felt the need to make a video explaining the lore in just five minutes .

news.title: 《Elden Ring》更新补丁说明揭示了多年来最大的变化
news.summary: FromSoftware has delivered a surprise Elden Ring update, revealing the biggest changes its critically acclaime

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2022/03/04/elden-ring-rune-farm-1646401242502.jpg
FromSoftware has delivered a surprise Elden Ring update, revealing the biggest changes its critically acclaimed action-RPG has gotten in years.

The developer caught fans off-guard with lengthy patch notes today, detailing a list of buffs (and a few nerfs) for different weapons and playstyles across the game. It's a major update that arrived as FromSoftware prepares for the launch of Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition for Nintendo Switch 2, as well as its accompanying DLC for other platforms.

What we have here is a laundry list of balance adjustments that get under the hood to tweak a variety of PvE and PvP tools. Based on the list of updates available on the Dark Souls developer's website , the last time we received patch notes of a similar length was back in October 2024, a few months after the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion released. That makes it not only one of the biggest updates the 2022 game-of-the-year winner has received in years, but what could be one of its final ones, too.

Generally, what Elden Ring players have to look forward to is a lot of buffs. The Firespark, Lightning, Chilling, Frenzyflame, and Deadly Poison Perfume Bottles, for example, got increased attack power across the board. The Smithscript Axe and Spear, as well as the Spear of the Impaler, also benefit from reduced stamina use and increased power for thrown attacks.

The August Elden Ring update also comes with increased guard boost and reduced weight for the Lordsworn's Shield, Briar Greatshield, Spiked Palisade Shield, and more. Others, such as the Wooden Greatshield, Cuckoo Greatshield, Redmane Greatshield, and Crucible Hornshield, also got increased guard boost.

Another big change hits everyone's favorite FromSoftware mechanic: parries. You'll now notice improved parry performance across the board, for example, with the developer also explaining it's reduced the time before certain actions can be performed when using things like Daggers, Curved Swords, and Small Shields post-parry.

The nerfs, meanwhile, hit the Gravitational Missile and Great Katana. The former has been altered so that its projectile will not explode upon impact with terrain, while the latter now suffers from increased damage when hit by other players during an attack. The update also squashed bugs related to the Great Katana weapon, as well as a few PC-exclusive glitches.

For a game that turned four years old back in February, Elden Ring is still going strong. How much juice is left in the tank remains to be seen, though, as FromSoftware is very much staying busy with other projects . The Duskbloods , for example, may be a Switch 2 exclusive , but judging by the reactions to its first network test , it could compete with the studio's other multiplayer experiences.

Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition will keep the train rolling when it launches tomorrow, August 28, for Switch 2 owners, with all of today's updates in tow. The Tarnished Pack DLC – which includes the Heavy Knight and Idus Knight starting classes, three Torrent skins, and four new armor sets – will also release for other platforms tomorrow.

Today's update is out now for players across PC, PlayStation 4, PS5, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X/S. You can check out the full patch notes below. You can also learn about the social media post that had fans hoping to return to the Lands Between for even more content.

news.title: 《Helldivers 2》的老板很高兴《GTA 6》在发布时跳过了 PC 版，并且立即没有在线版本
news.summary: Pretty much everyone expects the November launch of GTA 6 to dominate the world of entertainment — indeed that

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/25/ultimate-edition-saras-salon-02-1782379342733.jpg

Pretty much everyone expects the November launch of GTA 6 to dominate the world of entertainment — indeed that’s one of the reasons we have a September crush of video game releases. But according to the CEO of Helldivers 2 developer Arrowhead, there are two very good reasons why developers shouldn’t be too worried.

Speaking to IGN, Arrowhead boss Shams Jorjani said that the lack of a PC version of GTA 6 at launch, as well as the absence of whatever the next generation of GTA Online looks like, means there’s reason to believe games like Helldivers 2 retain their own space.

“Rockstar makes ridiculous, high-effort stuff and it's awesome that games like this get made,” Jorjani said. “On a selfish level I'm happy it’s not hitting PC right away, and that online isn’t dropping at launch. It means Helldivers 2 gets to keep crushing it in our own space, and is also why it won’t be the all consuming behemoth everyone’s worried about.

“Everyone in the industry right now is constantly pivoting strategies and obsessing over early player feedback just to survive. But Rockstar has the brand power to confidently take their time and run their classic play. They have the confidence and freedom to spend a decade doing things the old-school way because they know the core game will deliver. It’s going to raise the bar for sure.”

Of course, Helldivers 2 is also out on console (it’s a PlayStation Studios game and Sony owns the Helldivers IP), but the explosive co-op action game is particularly strong on Steam, where it retains a loyal and sizeable audience of fans even now, two-and-a-half years after launch.

You’d image that the launch of GTA 6 will have an impact on even PC games, but perhaps long-running Steam games that revolve around online play will prove more resilient than others. Let's remember: GTA 6 is a single-player game at launch. There's no online mode at all this November.

GTA 6 is also set for launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S only, which in 2026 feels like an odd release strategy but is in keeping with Rockstar’s playbook. Jorjani touches on this in his comment — Rockstar is perhaps one of the few video game developers around that can guarantee success even skipping PC. GTA 6 is just that big of a deal. There’s nothing like it.
Be sure to check out IGN’s GTA 6 official gameplay reveal live blog , where we’ll bring you all the news across the internet on today’s Netflix exclusive and beyond.

news.title: 《侠盗猎车手 6》揭晓现场报道：解析 Netflix 的“扩展观看”活动
news.summary: We're cataloging everything we learn about GTA 6 from the Netflix reveal, as well as reactions from around the

content.v: After years of speculation and rumors, Rockstar is finally giving us a deeper official look at Grand Theft Auto 6. (Unlike the various unofficial looks we've been getting courtesy of a certain vegetable .)
The GTA 6 "Extended Look" airs Thursday, August 27 on Netflix at 12 pm PDT/3 pm EDT/8 pm BST. Six hours later, it'll be available on Rockstar's YouTube channel.

Rockstar has not said exactly what the video will entail, but we're assuming we'll see a good amount of gameplay and find out more about our two lead characters, Lucia and Jason. We'll be responding live to the reveal in the blog feed below, cataloging all the details and sharing reactions from around the web.

GTA 6 is due out on consoles on November 19. There's frustratingly still no PC release date, and Rockstar is unlikely to speak on that anytime soon. Perhaps we'll at least hear something about GTA Online, which has been conspicuously absent from the conversation so far.
What we've learned from the leaks
Ahead of the official GTA 6 reveal, someone who goes by "Cyberleek" has been releasing gameplay clips that apparently come from a build of the game they have continuous access to.

I assume there's a control room somewhere in which suited lawyers are pointing at giant maps and saying "enhance," but Rockstar hasn't tracked down the leaker yet, and in the meantime, we've learned a lot about GTA 6's gameplay.
Here are some of the big details, with the caveat that we can't be sure exactly how recent Cyberleek's build is:
The GTA 6 reveal is 'rousing' and 'violent'
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JMgbsscgCzhTqWEzZBs2SF.png
That's according to the descriptors Netflix has chosen for the reveal. According to the Netflix mobile app, the video will be 26 minutes long.

I still think it's quite poor form for Rockstar to make fans subscribe to Netflix to see the reveal of a game they've probably already preordered. Yes, we can all just wait six hours for it to be posted on YouTube (and realistically, it'll be ripped from Netflix well before that), but it's the principle of the thing.
PC Gamer's Andrea Shearon has reminded me that Hannibal is on Netflix—the brilliant NBC show with Mads Mikkelsen—so I guess that's what I'll be doing with the renewed subscription I didn't want.
We're 30 minutes away
It's almost time. The anticipation for this big reveal has perhaps been dulled by the leaks that preceded it, but I still find myself quite curious to see what Rockstar is going to show.

So far, we've gotten the impression that GTA 6 is going to be something of a hybrid between previous GTAs and Red Dead Redemption 2, and that may manifest in deeper ways than we've seen from the infamous vegetable's clips.

I don't expect to hear much, or possibly anything, about GTA Online, but even if it's omitted, the fact of its omission will be notable. Rockstar surely has big plans for its future, but given how closely GTA Online (and its roleplaying community in particular) is associated with PC gaming, I wonder if those plans will be withheld until the studio is ready to talk about the PC version of GTA 6 itself.
There are also rumblings about user generated content being a focus, and but I'm unsure if that will have anything to do with the singeplayer game—we'll see!
Here we go!

The time has come! Reminder that, if you don't have a Netflix subscription, the video will be available on YouTube six hours from now. But we'll be documenting what we see over the next several hours, and will grab stills images and clips of the most interesting stuff.

news.title: Rockstar Games 和佛罗里达州官员正在商讨如何将迈阿密打造成现实生活中的罪恶都市，以开展 GTA 6 的营销活动
news.summary: Florida officials and Rockstar Games are having conversations to turn parts of Miami into Vice City for Grand

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/18/jason-and-lucia-03-landscape-1781798123709.jpg
Florida officials and Rockstar Games are having conversations to turn parts of Miami into Vice City for Grand Theft Auto 6's marketing campaign.

As initially reported by The Miamian , Miami-Dade County has had formal conversations with Rockstar Games about a Grand Theft Auto 6-themed takeover of Miami to promote the upcoming game. The report initially noted that Rockstar was the one that approached Miami-Dade with its ideas, but the article was later edited to clarify the city was actually the one who submitted a pitch deck.

While no plans are officially in place yet, the ideas pitched by the city are wide-ranging, ambitious, and likely absurdly expensive. One such idea includes transforming a section of Miami International Airport to serve as a "welcome" area for Vice City, complete with Vice City signage, limited edition luggage tags, themed luggage carts, a photo backdrop, and even a display aircraft wrapped in the game's purple color scheme.

Officials also proposed various activations around Miami's beaches, parks, and ports, creating unique events with DJs, food, exotic vehicles, photo ops, drone shows, murals, and much more. Outside of actual events, there are even ideas to have Rockstar take over the city's busses and trains with Vice City branding on the actual locomotives and stations associated with them. On the smaller side, there was also a pitch for Vice City-branded manhole covers and utility boxes.

The city created a number of proposals that would actually permanently help Miami in the long term, such as the creation of more bus shelters, quality of life improvements for its parks, and more. One of the more unique suggestions included the construction of a "radio lab" at a library in downton Miami. This would give visitors access to recording and editing equipment to produce music, podcasts, and more.

In a statement to The Miamian, Carlos Suarez, a spokesperson for Miami-Dade Mayor Daniella Levine Cava, confirmed that they've had conversations with Rockstar Games, but there are no concrete plans in place at the moment.

“Nothing has been formally agreed to or approved, and any idea would have to go through the appropriate review and approval process," said Suarez. "Given Miami-Dade's clear influence on the game, we think there could be a unique opportunity to generate revenue for the County while showcasing Miami-Dade to a massive audience.”

It wouldn't be surprising if Rockstar uses the city of Miami to promote GTA 6 as part of its expansive marketing campaign, but it seems unlikely that it would go forth with all of these ideas. Not only are they expensive, but they may not all make sense for what Rockstar is envisioning for its advertising campaign.

The final marketing push for GTA 6 will ramp up today when Rockstar premieres an extended look at the game on Netflix . If you don't have Netflix or simply don't have time to watch, IGN will be doing a live blog with all of the big news from Rockstar's reveal. Additionally, a few new details were revealed yesterday including tidbits about specific gameplay mechanics and Rockstar doubling its size in order to produce GTA 6 .
Cade Onder is a freelancer for IGN's news team. He covers all things entertainment, including gaming, film, and more. You can find him on Twitter @Cade_Onder.

news.title: Devolver Digital 公布了《GTA 6》的竞争对手，这是一款不存在的重制版的重制版
news.summary: Few game companies are brave enough to go head-to-head with the release of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 , but

content.v: Few game companies are brave enough to go head-to-head with the release of Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 , but that's exactly what publisher Devolver Digital is doing with the launch of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed on November 19.

Billed as a "remaster of the second remake of the original monochrome action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time," Volvy's Adventure is actually almost none of those things. The original "Volvy's Adventure" doesn't exist. This isn't a remaster but an entirely new and original game. Volvy, while actually being Devolver Digital's tongue-in-cheek platformer mascot, is obviously not the most famous of "all time."

So what is Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, actually? It's a Game Boy Color-style 2D platformer coming to Steam from developer Doinksoft, the studio behind 2D sidescrollers like Gato Roboto and Gunbrella . Volvy himself is a rat-esque (I think?) creature with one big hand and one small hand.

Like any good platforming mascot, Volvy dashes and jumps through levels while collecting items (in this case, onions), bouncing on the heads of enemies, and battling bosses. Occasionally, Volvy transforms into a hulked out alter-ego called Swolvy capable of smashing through anything that gets in his way.

It's all a little absurd, but that's also what makes it fun. While much of the marketing and the entire premise of Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed comes off as a meta-video-game-industry joke, the actual game on display in its debut trailer looks like a rollicking good time.

Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is immediately reminiscent of its Game Boy Color-era inspirations, with a vibrant art style, a popping soundtrack, and kinetic movement. Volvy can dash through the air with his giant fist, burrow underground, or hover like a helicopter using his tail, and the trailer shows how all these abilities can all be chained together.

GTA 6 will certainly be hogging the headlines when it releases in November, but the open-world crime simulator isn't everyone's cup of tea, is $80 (or $100) , and isn't releasing on PC at launch. Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, at only $5, offers a nice bit of counterprogramming then for those who are looking for something else to do November 19.
Surprisingly, Volvy isn't the only one bold enough to release on the same day as GTA 6. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ Online, a port adding online co-op, is also releasing November 19.

news.title: 我解决了侠盗猎车手5中的男性孤独症流行病
news.summary: Reach out to your fellow human beings. And give them piggybacks.

content.v: Men. What is wrong with them and how can they be fixed?

Philosophers and scientists have asked this for generations, but the problem has only become understandable—and tractable—with the advent of modern technology. They are lonely. Contrary to the popular aphorism, all men are islands, struggling to exist in tempest-tossed seas. I have tried to solve this before, at least for Franklin, Trevor, and Michael, by introducing Pokémon to Los Santos. This did not work, and only resulted in me beating Charmander to death in the street.

The gentlemen of GTA require human companionship, not magical pets. They must find in others what is missing in themselves. They must use the 2gether mod for GTA 5 , which allows you to approach random NPCs and adorn yourself with them like they are some kind of boa or backpack. This is what friendship is all about.

The good news is: the people of Los Santos are remarkably pliable. No one objects to hopping on your back, or assuming the lotus position in your cupped hands, and they are utterly unfazed by the chaos unleashed by all the mods I have previously installed: flying cars, ongoing gang warfare, and so on.

To test their quietude, I asked a hiker to nestle himself in my hands as I attempted to sprint through an intersection. He was utterly placid as we were struck by three cars in a row, his murmured 'om mani padmi hum'* unbroken as an expensive German car used our combined mass as a ramp by which it could enter heaven.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/4zBxLbnU9T8BfTRQwyi886.gif

It was a true friendship, but it had to end eventually. Satisfied by his invincible tranquillity, I returned him to the nature spot in which I found him. Setting him down, he wandered off into a bush. In the distance, a Winnebago caught the sun as it drifted into the sky.
*He didn't actually say this, but I like to imagine he did.

news.title: Xbox CEO 对于《上古卷轴 6》是否会跳过 PlayStation 犹豫不决
news.summary: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has suggested Microsoft could make more exclusive games again , but will The Elder Scroll

content.v: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has suggested Microsoft could make more exclusive games again , but will The Elder Scrolls 6 be among them? We still don't know, but that's the question the BBC asked Sharma at Gamescom this week. But first, Sharma discussed her thoughts generally about exclusives, and how every platform, in her estimation, needs some form of exclusive content to grow.

"We are increasingly going to be one of the largest platforms in the world. Every platform needs some form of exclusive experiences and content," she said. "And so, what we've shared is Gears of War: E-Day and Clockwork [Revolution will be exclusive on console to Xbox]. We're going to do the best we can to continue to do that, all in context of the business being healthy, and so we have to balance that."

Pressed to say if it is a "priority" to make The Elder Scrolls 6 exclusive to Xbox on console, Sharma smiled and said, "It's a beautiful game." Sharma recently visited the developers at Bethesda and offered an update on how the game was progressing . During her visit, protestors came to Bethesda's offices to drag Sharma for her decision to lay off thousands of Xbox developers , including people working on The Elder Scrolls 6.
Due to these layoffs and other cuts, staffers at Bethesda are facing "crushing morale" and fears of more delays.

In terms of Microsoft's approach exclusive games going forward, the team has said it will honor existing agreements for Xbox-made games that were previously announced as multiplatform releases. The Elder Scrolls 6 was announced in 2018, but at the time, Bethesda did not confirm platform details. Microsoft acquired Bethesda in 2021, and documents from the Microsoft vs. FTC case said The Elder Scrolls 6 was not planned for PS5 .

Former Xbox boss Phil Spencer, for his part, said in 2021 that making games exclusive to Xbox is "not about punishing any other platform." He also alluded to the possibility of The Elder Scrolls 6 being exclusive to Xbox.

"In order to be on Xbox, I want us to be able to bring the full complete package of what we have. And that would be true when I think about The Elder Scrolls 6," he said. "That would be true when I think about any of our franchises."

Spencer spearheaded the effort to bring more Xbox games to rival platforms in a bid to make more money. He left Xbox earlier this year, and one of Sharma's first moves was to tell fans how important exclusives are to the business . Gears of War: E-Day, which launches this October, was reportedly planned for PS5 before Microsoft opted to make it exclusive on console to Xbox.
Despite being announced more than eight years ago, The Elder Scrolls 6 still has no release date or official details.

news.title: 有史以来最贵的 Xbox 已售罄，人们已经开始以数千美元的价格出售它
news.summary: Microsoft opened up preorders for its limited-edition 25th-Anniversary Xbox Series X, and within a minute, the

content.v: Microsoft opened up preorders for its limited-edition 25th-Anniversary Xbox Series X, and within a minute, the most expensive Xbox ever sold out. While units will likely make their ways into the hands of Xbox fans with deep pockets, it looks like scalpers have also snatched up units, and as you'd expect, they're expecting to make a big payday by flogging them on sites like eBay.

A quick look at the commerce platform reveals dozens of the rare Xbox Series X consoles have been listed, with prices ranging from $2,200 all the way up to an incredibly optimistic $27,426 by one seller in Australia--likely as a way to grab the top spot on eBay's search page. Microsoft opened up preorders with a $900 asking price for the console, so this is quite the jump. So far, it looks like quite a few of the consoles have been sold at the marked-up price, with several sales on eBay averaging between $1,900 to $2,300 per unit sold.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Xbox-Ebay.jpg?w=636

This is also an unpleasant reminder of the early years of the current console generation, as thanks to a semiconductor shortage, the Xbox Series X and the PS5 were hard to find. Scalpers using a variety of methods and programs were quick to snatch up restocks online and resold them, but supply chains eventually stabilized and access to the current console generation was easier--at least until a variety of factors saw their prices surge upwards last year, with no sign of relief in the immediate future.

This is also yet another thing that scalpers have ruined, as many hobbies has been impacted by hustle culture. The Pokemon Trading Card Game has been especially hard hit , as every new restock at retailers usually sees scalpers buy up all of the available stock. Not even Pokemon donuts are safe , as the recent Krispy Kreme collaboration attracted plenty of people looking to make a quick buck.

news.title: Arc Raiders 将在 10 月份的重大更新中添加相机模式，但一些粉丝需要更多证据来证明该游戏不会消失
news.summary: This would've been really cool eight months ago.

content.v: We're getting dribs and drabs of news about Arc Raiders ' upcoming major update which is scheduled for October. A new "high-level" challenge has been promised to returning players, alongside a frozen map full of new arcs, plus there'll also be the small addition of a photo mode.

"Time to remember your raids, cameras are coming to the Rust Belt in October," a new social media post reads. By the looks of things this will let players record all the weird, wonderful, and downright stupid antics they get up to during Arc Raiders sessions. The only problem is, well, that the games just aren't as enjoyable as they used to be.
New Camera gadget coming in the October update!This looks pretty cool honestly pic.twitter.com/65vcFbk0iW August 26, 2026

Arc Raiders has had its issues with cheaters for almost as long as it's been out. While PvE lobbies are still ok, PvP is a swamp of bad actors right now, and it's only been getting worse the more decent people leave, meaning cheaters take up a bigger portion of the playerbase. Some are even throwing themselves in front of friendly fire just so they can trigger a self-defense clause and murder without consequence, you just can't win against these guys.

So with all things considered, players aren't exactly overjoyed about photo mode when the house is on fire. "Using number keys as a heal bind [has] been bugged since near launch," one player says , detailing how borked their hotkeys are. "But sure, let's add a fucking camera!"
"We finally need proof that we can believe what we have been promised, not just some gimmick to string us along," another player adds.

The frustration with Arc Raiders is clear, but I have to say I don't think it's fair to completely write the October update off before we've been able to play it for ourselves. I think it actually makes sense that Embark hasn't given too much away far in advance, hype would peter out quickly otherwise. I'm actually really excited to see the October update for myself, I'd love for it to spur on another stretch of raiding.

That isn't to say, however, that the October update doesn't have a lot to prove. On release Embark promised a grand 10-year plan for Arc Raiders. It hasn't even been a year since then, and that promise seems to be teetering on the brink. October might be the developer's final chance to convince players that this game really does have enough to take it further, because I fear patience is running thin.

news.title: 德国总统警告游戏的负面影响，包括带有“极端主义意识形态”的游戏
news.summary: This year's Gamescom event is underway in Cologne, Germany, and now the country's president, Frank-Walter Stei

content.v: This year's Gamescom event is underway in Cologne, Germany, and now the country's president, Frank-Walter Steinmeier--speaking at the event itself--warned people to consider the downsides to gaming. He also said gaming is great and has lots of positive effects on people and society.

As reported by DPA International, he said video games have "become so ubiquitous," so it's only prudent to "discuss the downsides of this development." He said people should look at video games "objectively, honestly, and in a nuanced way."

Steinmeier pointed out how the World Health Organization has warned of the dangers of gaming addiction , and he went on to say some video games expose people to "brutality and raw violence, to sexism, racism, inhuman thinking, and extremist ideologies."

Also during his speech, Steinmeier said it's an outdated way of thinking to believe a "gamer" is someone who plays video games 24/7, eats junk food, and drinks energy drinks in a dark room. This "does not do justice to reality," he said.

"Games have long since found their place at the heart of our society," he said, adding that advancements to gaming technology have helped various other industries, including medicine, architecture, and motor vehicle design.

Gamescom 2026 kicked off with Geoff Keighley's Opening Night Live event, where a lot of announcements were made . The show itself is underway now, and for more, you can read GameSpot's interview with the organizers about how the biggest gaming event in the West continues to grow .

news.title: 《腐烂国度 3》宣布今年晚些时候进行封闭 Beta 游戏测试
news.summary: State of Decay 3 fans will have the chance to play the game later this year via a closed beta.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2024/06/09/sod2-1717953324498.png
State of Decay 3 fans will have the chance to play the game later this year via a closed beta.

Undead Labs has confirmed that it will hold a closed beta for State of Decay 3 before the end of 2026. Exact dates weren't given, but interested fans can sign up now by clicking here and filling out the required information. The studio also held an alpha earlier this year, which reportedly resulted in actionable feedback to improve the game. The team noted that the alpha allowed them to improve combat, cosmetics, visuals, and movement, resulting in a better product. The beta will only allow more opportunities to improve the game, according to Undead Labs.

“We’re going to be expanding our alpha and then closed beta to more players over time, this is our largest map ever and with untethered multiplayer, we really need to take the opportunities to stress-test and fine-tune,” said Kevin Patzelt, Creative Director at Undead Labs. “If you don’t get access right away, rest assured there will be more opportunities throughout the year for players familiar and brand new to the series.”

State of Decay 3 has been in the works since at least 2020, when the game was announced at the Xbox Series X/S reveal event. The project went quiet for a number of years, but was re-revealed in 2024 and is now planned for release sometime in 2027 . It's been a long road, and it hasn't been an easy one. Undead Labs is also splitting away from Xbox, as part of the platform's big reset. Xbox underwent a massive restructuring earlier this summer , leading to extensive layoffs and multiple studios being sold off or released to go independent.

Undead Labs is in the process of transitioning out of Xbox, though it's currently unclear what the studio's new path is, such as acquisition by another company or forging its own path. Additionally, it has been reported that Undead Labs will not be obligated to bring State of Decay 3 to Xbox Game Pass once it leaves Xbox. However, the blog post announcing the closed beta noted that the game is still planned for a Game Pass release. So, I guess we'll just have to wait and see what happens.
State of Decay 3 will release on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC next year.

news.title: 粉丝们相信《GTA 6》泄密者已经“套现”并据报道赚取了约 27 万美元
news.summary: Analysis of overnight cryptocurrency transactions points to the prolific GTA 6 leaker having "cashed out" of t

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta-5-money-kee1mzx-1787844722861.jpg
Analysis of overnight cryptocurrency transactions points to the prolific GTA 6 leaker having "cashed out" of their meme coin, earning around $270,000 in the process.

That's according to reliable GTA watcher and crypto analyst Vice Cit , who previously posted evidence that strongly suggested the leaking antics of "Cyberleek" were part of a cryptocurrency scheme , rather than their claimed excuse of it being a protest against the death of physical media.

Every video posted by the person or persons known as Cyberleek has pointed to a website where fans could pay to vote on further leaks using the leaker's own cryptocurrency. These leaks have since increased in frequency over the past few days, and also escalated in terms of the content they showed — revealing full frontal nudity in one recent video, and then finally beginning to spoil the game's story in the latest clip posted to date .

The rapid release of more leaks, as well as Rockstar's own impending official reveal of gameplay footage via Netflix, suggested to some fans that Cyberleek was getting ready to make their move and earn whatever money they could before interest waned and their currency inevitably collapsed.

Indeed, this now appears to be the case, with Cyberleek apparently pocketing all the currency's trading fees and transferring them into at least two other sources overnight, ready for withdrawal. Vice Cit has a detailed log of where the money went, up to a point, but not enough to help identify who was actually behind it all. The fact that multiple withdrawal methods were allegedly used could point to multiple people being behind Cyberleek, Vice Cit speculated, though this cannot be confirmed.

Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught now seems to rely on how successful Rockstar's legal team and the relevant law authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible.

"The original setup of this whole project (the CYBERLEEK token, the website, and the file uploads) was around $29,000 at the time of my first investigation," Vice Cit wrote. "Which means the person or group behind this leak profited around $241,000 if this is where this all ends. Not an amount to completely dismiss but is it really 'risk your freedom money'?

"I personally believe the leaker expected to make much more from this project and the watermark messaging in the most recent clips feels kind of panicky. As the coin continued to drop over the last 24 hours and the public started to lose interest I believe the leaker made the choice to cash out."

And then there's the million dollar (or $241,000) question: Are the GTA 6 leaks over? There's no reason why Cyberleek couldn't release more footage, and no suggestion they were close to getting caught. Indeed, it would be the ultimate test of Cyberleek actually caring about their stated cause of physical media if they continued posting even now. Time will tell, though at the time of writing Rockstar is now just hours from taking center stage.

news.title: 《巫师 3》重制版发售前价格悄然上涨
news.summary: The Witcher 3 has gotten a price increase ahead of the release of the game's remaster next month.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/03/25/witcher-3-easl-br-1774455428792.jpg
The Witcher 3 has gotten a price increase ahead of the release of the game's remaster next month.

Earlier this week, CD Projekt Red surprised fans by announcing a new remaster for The Witcher 3 . It will feature visual enhancements, changes to combat, and much, much more. The best part? It's completely free to existing owners of The Witcher 3 and if you don't already own the DLCs, you're getting those for free. However, if you haven't bought the game, you will now have to pay a bit extra.

The price of The Witcher 3: Complete Edition on Steam has jumped from $39.99 to $49.99 since the announcement of the remaster. This will be the price of the remaster itself, so fans who buy the existing version are essentially paying for the new version upfront since their copy will be automatically upgraded. It's not a huge jump, but may be a bummer for those who have been waiting for the right opportunity to buy The Witcher 3 and now have to pay a bit more, especially since the game is 11 years old.

The Witcher 3 is arguably worth the price of admission, though. The game, with all of its DLCs and side quests, is hundreds of hours long and is highly replayable. It's one of the best RPGs of all-time and there's a new DLC for the game releasing next year ahead of The Witcher 4's expected release in 2028 . As noted, CD Projekt Red also offers deep discounts on The Witcher 3 constantly (I got the Complete Edition for $4 on Steam last Christmas). It wouldn't be surprising if the game goes on sale by the end of the year or in time for the game's new DLC next year, if you don't want to pay full price.

news.title: 作为微软自称的“对游戏保存更广泛承诺”的一部分，Xbox 光盘现在将允许对游戏进行数字访问
news.summary: Microsoft saw Sony's open goal and took the shot.

content.v: Microsoft has dabbled in dubious DRM over the years, having previously announced then unannounced disc-based DRM for the Xbox One back in 2013. Sony scored some free public praise on that blunder . Yet it seems like the pendulum has finally swung the other way. Sony has announced it is ending support for physical games entirely, while Microsoft will let users add physical games to their digital games library.

Microsoft says, "Players have spent decades building their Xbox libraries. Some games were purchased on disc. Some were purchased digitally" It says its "goal is to make it easier for those libraries to move forward with players" and "this is part of our broader commitment to game preservation."

This program will begin to roll out for Xbox Insiders starting August 31 and will start with a few thousand titles. Effectively, the disc can be 'claimed' on an account, giving you access even when your disc is not in the disc tray. Interestingly, this also gives you access to the game via Xbox Play Anywhere and Xbox Cloud Gaming, which means you can play it from your phone or PC, complete with cloud saves.

The physical game will still function as normal, even after it has been added to your account. That means you can technically lend it to a friend. The license to add the game to your digital library is revocable, so if someone accidentally adds it to their account, you can remove it if you have the physical disc. This means it shouldn't have an effect on the preowned games market, as anyone who buys an already digitally claimed game can simply revoke the license.

Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced this new feature via their X account , and has since received almost 200,000 likes and over 24 million views as of the time of writing. This is to say the announcement seems to be going down well.

Your physical game library is more than a collection of discs. It holds years of memories and stories worth preserving. Starting next week, XBOX Insiders can unlock a digital entitlement for supported physical games. We’ll start with thousands of titles and add more as we can. pic.twitter.com/XATsa8sjBt August 26, 2026

And Microsoft is in desperate need of that good PR. Just last month , it announced it would be laying off 3,200 people and dumping four studios in what it calls "the most significant restructure in Xbox history." This is before mentioning the criticism Microsoft was already getting from the BDS movement for ties to the Israeli government and military.

But one question does go unanswered here, and that is whether or not Xbox will continue supporting discs in the next generation. As I noted in my conversation with game preservation group DoesItPlay , consoles going all-in on digital games feels like more of a hot topic than our long disc-free PCs. Microsoft and Sony own the platform, and the stores to buy games on it.

Sony removing a disc drive means that the only way players can buy its games legally is through its own storefront. This gives Sony ultimate control over pricing, ownership, and DRM, and it's easy to understand why Microsoft might want to take a bigger cut of the pie too, especially with the rising prices of hardware.
And Microsoft saying this allows players to 'move forward' certainly signals the all-digital future alarm bell to this writer.
Still, with the next generation of both consoles anticipated to launch around the end of next year (or maybe even the year after), we know roughly when we'll get our answer.

news.title: 天哪，它正在发生：矮人要塞将在今年晚些时候获得第一个神话与魔法更新，为每个玩家的世界带来自己的程序魔法系统
news.summary: "Everything that makes fantasy what it is—with every piece tied into how that particular universe works, down

content.v: Even as it achieved fractal complexity by modeling feline alcohol poisoning, procedural bardic traditions, and delayed-action thermonuclear dragonfire , the creators of Dwarf Fortress—brothers Tarn and Zach Adams—have maintained still loftier ambitions for their legendary fantasy sim. In recent years, that effort has been guided by one goal: Creating magic. Procedural, universe-specific magic, interwoven with the unique cosmology and mythology modeled each and every time the player clicks the "create new world" button.

For a game already setting a high watermark for simulational complexity, it's an incredibly ambitious endeavor. It's taken a decade. It's demanded a complete scripting overhaul, aided by the heroic effort of Bay 12 Games' first non-Adams programmer , Putnam. Frankly, it's almost strained believability. And it'll start arriving later this year.

Tarn Adams confirmed that Dwarf Fortress' first Myth and Magic update will land before the end of the year in a short announcement video , embedded above. His goal, he said, was to create "procedural magic systems that go beyond combining spell effects and go straight to the fundamental cosmological makeup of the universe," enabling "magical situations that you cannot get any other way."

It's a notion Adams has shared as we've spoken with him about his Myth and Magic ambitions for years, going back to 2017 : By creating a procedural magic system that's anchored in each world's simulated creation myths and cosmology, Dwarf Fortress wouldn't be generating world variations to play within—it would become an entire fantasy setting generator, conjuring universes with their own emergent forms of magic that are as fundamental as the laws of physics.
"It allows your fortresses to pursue magical research that really feels like discovery," Adams said.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7YB7v9Jh7Qb2VXAeDsP5NV.png

The video's only a minute long, but it offers some brief glimpses of magic-wielding Dwarf Fortress figures in action. A goblin sorcerer teleports a cat. A dwarven wizard repeatedly force-blasts a goblin against a wall. A six-limbed fly-man holding four magic staves macerates a hallway full of enemy swordsmen with a barrage of magic bolts. A necromancer curses an innocent dwarf with undeath, and they immediately start ripping into a nearby comrade.

"Now, there will be magic effects that blow things up," Adams said over footage of magic projectiles rapidly demolishing a dwarven outpost. "There will also be magic materials, enchantments, rituals, ancient ruins, everything that makes fantasy what it is—with every piece tied into how that particular universe works, down to its bones."
The first Myth and Magic update doesn't have a release date yet, but Dwarf Fortress is available on Steam and at the Bay 12 Games site now.

news.title: 大约 20 年后，Arkane 的创始人表示，他理解 Valve 取消 Ravenholm 游戏的原因：“这一切都归结于经济因素”
news.summary: "We grew up and got a little bit more mature about it."

content.v: One of the quiet tragedies of Valve's game library is a standalone Ravenholm game that never came to fruition—it was being worked on by Arkane Studios in the late 2000s, and it would've probably been pretty damn good if Valve had the moolah to make it. Over a decade later, an entire hour of footage would drop online , with reports stating that around 10 levels had been fleshed out prior.
Now, almost 20 years later, Arkane's founder Raphaël Colantonio has managed to find his zen with the heartbreak, speaking with Press Box PR in an interview earlier this month (thanks, GamesRadar+ ).

"It took us a decade to move on from the pain of the Ravenholm project because we were incredibly excited about doing that game and we put in a lot of creative energy into it and eventually when the decision was made to cut it, we did not understand it as it happened," said Colantonio. "We were young and we were just refusing to see the reality of the situation, and the reality was much simpler than the way it looked to us."

Colantonio, who left Arkane in 2017 but was instrumental on one of its all-time greats, Dishonored, says that "it all came down to the economics behind Half Life 2 and how the DLCs were selling. They had a business ratio between how much they could spend and how they could make it to be worth it to them, because it takes the attention of the entire structure on their side."

With time to reflect, Colantonio views Arkane's involvement as more of an experiment in retrospect—especially given that a Ravenholm game had already been in development between 2005 and 2007: "They thought, you know, why not try these guys? We seemed pretty effective and eventually, like the two other attempts that they had looked at, we went somewhere with it, and it was cool. What we had was really, really cool.

"But it still needed more time, and too much time to finish … There was a business call at some point where it was decided that it didn’t really make sense. It was very painful for us but it made sense, we grew up and got a little bit more mature about it."

It's not all bad, though. It got them in touch with Viktor Antonov , a concept artist whose work was instrumental in forming the aesthetic of both Half Life and Dishonored. Antonov sadly died in 2025: "Eventually he joined us to create Dishonoured and we did not betray the Valve mentality. We learned a lot from them, actually. It’s just that we probably snuck in some of our own Arkane stuff in there as well."

Honestly, while I'm glad Colantonio's found peace, I can't help but feel a touch melancholy. The same Arkane that couldn't ship a game, but got a second chance with Dishonored in the 2010s, is now cleaved in two, with Arkane Austin closed entirely by Microsoft , and a thin film of French law protecting Arkane Lyon. Not that the earlier videogame industry was a cakewalk, Ravenholm's ill fate proves that, but still. It was a different time.

news.title: 星球大战：银河赛车手想要打破赛车游戏的舒适区
news.summary: Great racing games have an x-factor that sets them apart from their peers, but you could argue that the genre

content.v: Great racing games have an x-factor that sets them apart from their peers, but you could argue that the genre hasn't meaningfully evolved over the decades. Star Wars: Galactic Racer aims to change that perception, as the new title from developer Fuse Games looks to other genres for inspiration. While it might look like a spiritual successor to 1999's Star Wars Episode 1: Pod Racer, Galactic Racer adds in some roguelite flavor and a dash of Burnout to its take on high-speed competition in a galaxy far, far away.

"Our intention was actually to move the genre forward," Fuse Games CEO Matt Webster said to GameSpot. "We've made a lot of racing games in the past, and we love racing. This game came together because of a shared love of racing and Star Wars, but we needed to evolve. It needed to change; it needed to be something to push it forward and modernize it. It's probably the last sort of major genre that hasn't really had a transformative stealing of different types from different genres into racing."

"And so, that's what we did here. We wanted to make a racing adventure where story and character are very important. But we've wrapped it up inside a runs-based structure. Runs-based games are games that are designed for infinite replayability, and we think racing thrives on replayability. Our assertion was that those things were going to be a great mix, and now, as that comes to life, people are coming for the Star Wars arcade racing action, but there's a boatload of depth in there."

That all sounds like a fun recipe for single-player fun, but what about multiplayer? Online competition is a vital part of any racing game, and with a roguelite-influenced structure, you'd imagine that this wouldn't translate well to multiplayer racing. Fuse Games says that it has found a great balance for players who want to race against their fellow humans, as Galactic Racer's multiplayer leans heavy into the underworld aspect of Star Wars and allows you to place bets on how well you'll do in competitions.

"Multiplayer is amazing in this game, because what we've done is we've taken that sort of run-based chase, and we've compressed it into about 25, 30 minutes," Webster explained. "So, in Speeder Tours, there are 12 players, Pod Racing Tours has eight players, and the tours follow the same structure, which is six events. The first five events are a build chase, so your finishing position determines what rewards you get and what parts are available to you. But importantly, you bet on your finishing position. If I'm confident, I'm going to go all in, I'm going to say I'm going to come, I'm going to place in the top three. If I achieve that, I get an epic reward. If I don't get there, I don't get as good a reward. Or you might say top nine."

"If you achieve that, you get a decent part drop. So, every time, there's a decent opportunity for you to progress, and that solves a great challenge that we have in the past where if you didn't come first in a series of races online, you're kind of like, 'Well, I'm done. I'll just try my bet somewhere else.' Now, everybody has a chance, and I'm serious, where we've seen this, everyone has a chance to claw that back victory because the first five events are about building the best vehicle you can for the showdown event. The very last event is one where you put it all on the line, and there you're betting on who's going to win."
Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches on October 6 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

底盘硬件同样诚意十足，前双叉臂 + 后五连杆全铝悬架，标配高抓地静音轮胎，搭载最大 7° 后轮转向，转弯半径仅 5.4 米，大型轿车也能轻松完成窄路掉头，兼顾商务舒适与灵活操控。
把千公里CLTC续航、2.9秒破百、后轮转向、五屏豪华座舱这些配置打包，起售价落到24.99万区间，第一眼看上去，产品参数层面确实相当有竞争力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272257108482.png
但也要客观看待：到了D级旗舰轿车这个价位段，消费者购车已经不再单纯对比参数表。品牌认知、底盘实际调校质感、整车NVH、长期使用可靠性、售后体验，这些看不见摸不着的部分，同样决定一台旗舰车的真实价值。纸面硬件全部拉满，就代表它完全匹配旗舰定位吗？
对于普通家用、追求极致性价比、看重续航和性能的年轻用户、家庭用户而言，它极度划算。同价位无对手的硬件配置、越级的空间尺寸、无焦虑的续航、炸裂的加速性能，完全可以闭眼选择，是实打实的国货真香车型。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272257151292.png
但对于追求商务质感、品牌底蕴、长期保值率、极致行驶高级感的高端用户来说，它值得观望。参数堆料的优势足够亮眼，但旗舰车型的核心软实力，还需要时间和市场来验证。
不可否认的是，比亚迪大汉的上市，彻底改写了国内中高端纯电轿车的市场规则。它告诉整个市场：国产车已经有能力，用亲民价格，做出越级的旗舰产品。这是国产汽车工业的巨大进步，也是消费者的福音。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272257215787.jpg
这价格的比亚迪大汉值吗？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。

news.title: LIVE: Rockstar Set to Finally Reveal Official GTA 6 Gameplay, First on Netflix
news.summary: Today is the day Rockstar Games finally pulls back the curtain on the most anticipated video game of all time:

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/27/gta6-livecoverage-live-blogroll-1787842413539.jpg

Today is the day Rockstar Games finally pulls back the curtain on the most anticipated video game of all time: Grand Theft Auto 6 — and IGN is reporting live with all the news from across the internet.

GTA 6 was confirmed four-and-a-half years ago, when Rockstar said work on the next game in the phenomenally successful franchise was in development. Following two trailers and two public delays, we are now about to get an official gameplay reveal. Netflix goes first with its Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look , which will remain exclusive to the streaming platform for six hours. Netflix has said this reveal will be captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5, and will run 27 minutes.
Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look Netflix and YouTube global release times:

KST (Seoul):
JST (Tokyo):
CST (Shanghai):
GST (Abu Dhabi):
SAST (Johannesburg):
CEST (Paris):
BST (London):
BRT (Sao Paulo):
EDT (New York):
PDT (Los Angeles):

In the run up to today’s reveal, Rockstar has suffered a long list of gameplay leaks, which it responded to earlier this week . But enthusiasm for GTA 6 continues ahead of its November 19, 2026 release, and we’ll have all the news as it happens throughout the day, including the Netflix reveal itself and beyond.
So check out our live reporting below as the action unfolds. You won’t want to miss this one!
Rockstar and Florida Officials Are Reportedly Talking About Turning Miami Into Vice City IRL for GTA 6 Marketing Campaign

Florida officials and Rockstar Games are having conversations to turn parts of Miami into Vice City for GTA 6's marketing campaign. As initially reported by The Miamian , Miami-Dade County has had formal conversations with Rockstar about a GTA 6-themed takeover of Miami to promote the upcoming game. More here .
Helldivers 2 Boss Happy That GTA 6 Is Skipping PC at Launch and There's No Online Right Away

Pretty much everyone expects the November launch of GTA 6 to dominate the world of entertainment — indeed that’s one of the reasons we have a September crush of video game releases. But according to the CEO of Helldivers 2 developer Arrowhead, there are two very good reasons why developers shouldn’t be too worried. More here .
GTA 6 Leaker Has 'Cashed Out'
Analysis of overnight cryptocurrency transactions points to the prolific GTA 6 leaker having "cashed out" of their meme coin, earning around $270,000 in the process. More here .
Let's remember GTA 6 Trailer 2

Rockstar then released GTA 6 Trailer 2 in May 2025 , a year-and-a-half after Trailer 1. Anticipation was fever pitch at this point, with fans going down increasingly elaborate rabbit holes in their bid for new details and release date. The release of Trailer 2 came hot on the heels of a delay to GTA 6 itself , from fall 2025 to May 2026 (it would go on to be delayed again, to November 19, 2026).

GTA 6 Trailer 2 was captured on base PS5, as today's reveal is. "Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them," Rockstar said in the official description released at the time. "But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive."
If you need a refresh, Trailer 2 is below:
Let's remember GTA 6 Trailer 1

Rockstar formally announced GTA 6 in December 2023 with the release of Trailer 1. The developer confirmed the Trailer 1 launch window a month prior, issuing a rare statement from Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser:
In the end, Rockstar was forced to release GTA 6 Trailer 1 early due to a leak (GTA 6 and leaks have a long history). If you're struggling to remember what was in it, check out Trailer 1 below.
Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Have RPG Mechanics Like Eating, Exercising, and More

Ahead of the Netflix reveal, a cover story for Dazed magazine , revealed new information about GTA 6, which we've rounded up here . Highlights include players being able to eat, work out, and sleep, each of which has an impact on the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia.

news.title: 《GTA6》前瞻是PS5录制！但是标准版还是Pro版呢？
news.summary: Rockstar Games与Netflix合作推出的《GTA6》扩展前瞻即将于北京时间8月28日凌晨3点首播。官方确认，这段26分钟的视频“完全基于PS5…

content.v: 由你来说： 《GTA6》扩展前瞻已经确认为PS5实机录制，但官方并没有指出是标准版还是Pro版本，玩家们对此看法不一，你怎么看？
Rockstar Games与Netflix合作推出的《GTA6》扩展前瞻即将于北京时间8月28日凌晨3点首播。官方确认，这段26分钟的视频“完全基于PS5实机游戏画面录制”，但并未明确标注使用的是基础版PS5还是PS5 Pro。
这一模糊表述迅速引发玩家社群的热烈讨论。多数评论倾向于认为此次展示基于基础版PS5。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272234042400.jpg
有网友表示：“如果是Pro版，他们应该会直接说。”另一条高赞评论写道：“在基础版上展示反而更好，这说明他们对产品优化有信心，即使没有额外性能加持。”
也有玩家从用户基数角度分析：“在最多玩家拥有的机型上展示，才是最合理的做法。”
与此同时，部分玩家对性能表现表达了隐忧。有评论提及“我的Series S看到这些泄露都受创伤了”，暗示Xbox Series S用户可能对性能表现感到不安。
也有玩家理性分析：“他们应该对基础版PS5能稳定跑30帧、接近4K画质有信心。至于Pro版能有多大提升，我怀疑它能跑到60帧。”
更有玩家直言：“这些公司不会发布一款在基础版PS5上玩不了的游戏。基础版用户远多于Pro版，他们绝不可能抛弃基础版玩家。”
《GTA6》将于2026年11月19发售，登陆PS5与Xbox Series X|S平台。无论采用哪款机型录制，本次26分钟实机演示都将成为玩家评估游戏画面与性能表现的最直接依据。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/27/small_202608272234132422.png
